name: ActivityPub API
description: API helper used as a dependency for other modules that want to expose an API for ActivityPub (OAuth2 + REST base).
project_description: Submodule of the ActivityPub project. Provides the shared REST/OAuth2 plumbing (a REST ResourceBase, an authenticated-user-with-actor access check, OAuth2 consumer/token helpers, media upload handling and an API response service) that other modules — notably ActivityPub Mastodon API — build on to expose a client API for a Drupal ActivityPub server. Depends on core REST and the Simple OAuth module.
